newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV yr net 208 bln bolivars.
newsitem.headline: CANTV yr net 208 bln bolivars.

text.p: Venezuelan national telephone comapny CANTV said Wednesday year profits for 1996 reached 208 billion bolivars ($443 million), expressed in December 31 bolivars.
It did not provide comparative figures for the year before.
"With these results we are achieving our strategic objective of providing world class communications to the Venezuelan market," said company president Gustavo Roosen in a press release.
Roosen said the year saw consolidated profits top 1995 figures as costs were reduced by 19 percent while productivity grew by 22 percent.
Installed lines grew 108,000, or five percent, to reach 2.5 million, the release added, while subscribers to its cellular telephone business, Movilnet, grew 26 percent to reach 214,000.
